# Lynk Medical patient site

GLP-1 patient education pages, English and Spanish. Start at `Lynk_Patient_Hub.html` (add `?lang=es` for Spanish).

**Do not edit these files here.** They are generated from the private repo LG-Health/lg-patient-tools (`lynk-patient-ed.js`, built by `tools/build-lynk-patient.js`), which copies them into this repo. An edit made here is overwritten by the next build.
